extension.summary: Daylight - a skin that knows what time it is.
extension.description: Soft, rounded and calm. Its colours follow the day (pale morning, bright afternoon, amber evening, deep blue night) and Home suggests what fits right now: films that end before your bedtime, the next episode, something long when it rains (weather needs a weather add-on set in Kodi's Settings > Services > Weather). Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.21 - Counts read right at one: 1 season, 1 episode, 1 film, 1 track, 1 item. Smaller download: removed images the skin never used. v0.9.20 - Libraries: "Nothing here." no longer sits on the Back row of an empty folder (List and Grid views, Episodes and Rows). Select lists (languages, choices) no longer show a half-cut row at the bottom. Settings: Right on Look now enters the page when TMDb Helper is not installed (it did nothing and quietly switched Borrowed colour off).
